Question: Which assets have alarmed readings but no open work orders?

rank_trace.sql: SELECT a.asset_name FROM assets a WHERE a.asset_id IN (SELECT s.asset_id FROM sensor_readings s WHERE s.alarm_flag = 1) AND a.asset_id NOT IN (SELECT w.asset_id FROM work_orders w WHERE w.status = 'open');
